name: A4
mesh_airframe: Douglas A-4E Skyhawk, VA-12 livery (P3D exterior model, one rigid body, gear stowed)

license.license_name: All rights reserved; model author-owned, used with permission

note: Local model: assets_pipeline/a4_mdl_convert.py, not a fetched FlightGear tree. Not articulated: control surfaces, gear and speed brakes do not move.

dimensions_m.source: [unverified here] published A-4F overall length 40 ft 3 in (12.27 m) and height 15 ft (4.57 m), from memory of the type's standard characteristics; span is taken from the flown FDM's own <wingspan>

nose.source: measured 2026-10-01 from the visual model's vertices: A4.xml was regenerated by assets_pipeline/a4_sync.py from the model's aircraft.cfg, whose reference datum (the .mdl origin) is the FDM's structural origin and its CG (a4_sync.to_struct_in: x aft = -forward); the fuselage nose tip on the centreline (|y| < 30 cm), not the starboard refuelling probe

tail.source: measured 2026-10-01 from the visual model's vertices: A4.xml was regenerated by assets_pipeline/a4_sync.py from the model's aircraft.cfg, whose reference datum (the .mdl origin) is the FDM's structural origin and its CG (a4_sync.to_struct_in: x aft = -forward); the aftmost vertex (the fin's trailing tip)

alpha_stall_deg.reason: the JSBSim A4 model (Aeromatic v0.9) states no alpha limit

limits.note: A4.xml is an Aeromatic v0.9 model 'created using publicly available data, publicly available technical reports, textbooks, and guesses' (its own file header): unvalidated, so every limit monitored against it would be graded on a guessed airframe.

loading.source: assets/fdm_root/aircraft/A4/A4.xml <mass_balance> and <propulsion> (generated by assets_pipeline/a4_sync.py from the visual model's aircraft.cfg); the maximum weight from that aircraft.cfg's max_gross_weight 24500 lb [unverified here]

datum.xml: the A4.xml <location> x in inches, positive aft (the JSBSim structural frame), the empty CG at x 0

arm_comparison.reason: no NATOPS arm is transcribed for the A-4: the envelope check is refused by name (loading.datum_unverified) and the loading is flown at the XML's own arms

empty_weight.source: A4.xml <emptywt> 10450 LBS at <location name="CG"> x 0 in
